conclusions: The balanced three-BF16-core candidate fails:566483 raw partial differences and263108 reconstructed dots among1048576 cells; the matching four-IU8 partials, buffers and input immutability pass. No sequence benchmark or model runs follow this failed arithmetic gate.

The isolated probe checks all65536 core encodings/196608 BF16 conversions exactly. Across24 matrix cases/6291456 outputs, only the mixed-sign mode differs:67345 raw differences for each floating matrix/DOT2 path, maximum absolute error0.015625. Scalar FP32 is exact. All tested nonnegative, same-product-sign, one-hot, exact-cancellation and constant cases are exact.

Nearest-integer diagnostics are zero on these samples, but no snapping is admitted and no global error bound is inferred from observed maxima. These results localize an instruction-family numerical effect; they do not establish whether hardware, firmware or another implementation layer is responsible.
Disassembly of the failing comparison kernel confirms three BF16 WMMA and four IU8 WMMA instructions, with no extra FP multiply/divide operations or scratch accesses in that kernel.

Next investigate two exact IU8 partials plus one nonnegative FP16 matrix partial, with integer centering correction. The positive-input domain must be independently validated before any runtime integration. Existing canonical runtime dispatch remains unchanged.
